From: Makarius <makarius@sketis.net>

On 08/09/2026 13:04, Ananthajit Srikanth wrote:

I wanted to know if HOLCF is still in use for any project, or if it is still
maintained.
HOLCF is a regular session within the Isabelle distribution. Thus it is
"automagically maintained", according to the usual quality standards of Isabelle.

I don't know of any recent HOLCF-based projects, but there several entries in
Isabelle/AFP based on it. All of this is "automagically maintained", althouth
the quality standards for AFP are a bit lower than Isabelle.

Makarius

From: Ananthajit Srikanth <ananthajit@gmail.com>
